status_dictionary.label: Not assessed
status_dictionary.meaning: No structured jurisdiction-topic assessment is recorded.

status_dictionary.label: Source identified
status_dictionary.meaning: An official source is located but operative text has not been reviewed.

status_dictionary.label: Partially verified
status_dictionary.meaning: Some official evidence is reviewed but material gaps remain.

status_dictionary.label: Verified as of date
status_dictionary.meaning: Official text, amendments and supersession were checked on a recorded date.

status_dictionary.label: Implementation evidence found
status_dictionary.meaning: A specific domestic instrument or official assessment supports the stated scope.

status_dictionary.label: Proposed / consultation
status_dictionary.meaning: Official proposal or consultation only; not treated as final binding law.

status_dictionary.label: Superseded / repealed / cancelled
status_dictionary.meaning: Official evidence establishes the instrument's status ended or it was replaced.

status_dictionary.label: Not found in reviewed sources
status_dictionary.meaning: A defined official-source search found no evidence; this does not prove no law exists.

status_dictionary.label: Verification blocked
status_dictionary.meaning: An official source was identified but access or extraction failed.
